# Green Finance OS — Origo Platform

> Latin America green finance pipeline OS. Entity registry + compliance engine + investability scoring.

## API

Base URL: https://api.cleantechhub.net

[Entity Registry](/v1/entities) — Cross-product entity registry. POST to register, GET to list/search, PATCH for lifecycle transitions.
[Pipeline Stats](/v1/pipeline/stats) — Real-time funnel metrics across all entities.
[Pipeline Funnel](/v1/pipeline/funnel) — Stage distribution with conversion rates.
[Diagnostic Engine](/v1/diagnostic/run) — Run EUDR+CSRD+CDP compliance diagnostic for an entity.
[Admin Dashboard](/v1/admin/entities/stalled) — Stalled entities needing intervention.
[Admin Interventions](/v1/admin/interventions) — Entities at risk requiring action.
[Verifiable Credentials](/v1/entities/{id}/credentials) — W3C VCs for an entity.
[FI Dashboard](/v1/dashboard/fi) — Financial institution view: bankable entities by country.
[Investor Dashboard](/v1/dashboard/investor) — Fund manager view: verified entities by verde score.
[Multilateral Dashboard](/v1/dashboard/multilateral) — DFI funnel summary with tier and country breakdown.
[SME Dashboard](/v1/dashboard/sme) — SME self-service view with timeline and credentials.
